To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

application of poultry litter 10 t/ ha + carbofuron 3G 5 kg/ ha as spot application before planting was found to be the most effective in reducing severity of root knot nematode and economically viable alternative for the management of root knot nemtode in bidi tobacco.

poultry manure 10 t/acre + carbofuron 3G as a spot application before transplant of bidi tobacco recorded the lowest incidence (20%) of root-knot nematode with minimum root-knot index of 1.35 and maximum yield (1232 kg) with B:C ratio of (1:13.31) and found superior to rest of treatments.
poultry manure alone or poultry manure +carbofuran 6G (spot application) were found effective in reducing the root knot nematode incidence and increasing yield of bidi tobacco.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integrated management of root knot disease in bidi tobacco.
the integrated management of Meloidogyne incognita on Bidi tobacco.
the integrated management of root knot disease in bidi tobacco and the use of poultry manure and carbofuran as an alternative to chemical pesticides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
poultry manure alone or with carbofuran as spot application is an effective and eco-friendly alternative for the control of root knot nematode in bidi tobacco.
the poultry manure + 5 kg carbofuran/ha as spot treatment before transplanting of bidi tobacco is the best eco-friendly strategy to control the root-knot nematode in bidi tobacco.

poultry manure 10 t/ ha + carbofuron 5 kg / ha as spot application before planting was found most effective in reducing incidence and severity of the root knot nematode and economically viable alternative.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

application of poultry litter as organic manure along with chemical nematicide carbofuran as spot application was found to be the most effective treatment in reducing the incidence of root knot nematode and improving the quality of bidi tobacco.

poultry manure 10 t/ ha alone or poultry manure 5 t/ha + Carbofuran 2.5 kg/ha (spot application) as pre-transplanting treatment recorded significantly lower incidence and severity of root knot nematode disease in bidi tobacco.
application of poultry dung 1 t/acre + carbofuron 5 kg/acre as spot application recorded the least incidence of 20.1% and root knot index of 1.35.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integrated management approach can be used as a viable alternative to the use of chemical pesticides in the management of root knot nematode in bidi tobacco.
poultry manure alone or with carbofuran as spot application is effective in controlling root knot nematode and can be recommended for integrated management of the disease.
the use of poultry manure in combination with carbofuran can be an effective and eco-friendly approach in the integrated management of root-knot nematode disease in bidi tobacco.
